battle.name: 端平入洛
battle.brief: 端平元年（1234）金亡，宋理宗乘蒙古大軍北撤，遣全子才、趙葵北伐欲收復三京。塔察兒佯退北岸，卻掘開金堤淹宋軍糧道。七月五日宋軍入空汴京；七月末徐敏子、楊誼部攻洛，楊誼一軍在龍門以東中伏覆沒，徐敏子斷糧四日出退。宋軍十字弩裝填遲緩，難抵蒙古騎兵突馳，二軍敗走秦嶺淮河。

kit.name: 十字弩
kit.history: 弩把射速交給了機械，代價是裝填慢。城牆上它比長弓可靠，野戰裡它比長弓脆弱。

countries: 交戰的兩方，一方是剛滅金、握有江淮與兩浙的南宋朝廷，一方是剛完成滅金戰役、正把主力北撤的蒙古帝國及其收編的金朝降軍。南宋這邊的指揮體系以右丞相鄭清之領樞密院、兩淮制置司與淮西制置司的兵馬錢糧調度為核心：主持滅金之戰的京湖制置使史嵩之、鄂州江陵府駐紮御前諸軍副都統制孟珙自蔡州方向班師，奉金哀宗遺骨還臨安告廟；北伐則由淮南東路制置使兼知揚州事趙葵與兵部侍郎趙范兄弟統籌，廬州知州全子才率淮西兵為先鋒，部將徐敏子、楊誼各領一軍入洛。主張出兵的有鄭清之、趙范、趙葵，激烈反對的則有史嵩之、喬行簡、真德秀、吳淵、吳潛，理由是中原已遭戰亂破壞殆盡、無法供糧，宋軍又無騎兵，難守漫長的黃河防線，更恐授蒙古以口實。蒙古這邊由大汗窩闊台總節制，因糧草不足與天氣轉熱把主力北撤過黃河，只留速不台、塔察兒兩支機動部隊在黃河南岸遊弋，另以原金軍改編的漢軍守地方：劉福任河南道總管，都元帥張柔屯徐州，汴京仍有金朝降將崔立把守。聯手滅金的默契，就此翻為敵對。
countriesEn: The two sides were the Southern Song court, which had just destroyed the Jin and held the Jianghuai and Liangzhe regions, and the Mongol Empire, which had won the same war and was withdrawing its main force north of the Yellow River together with the Jin troops it had taken over. On the Song side the command structure ran through the right chancellor Zheng Qingzhi, the Bureau of Military Affairs, and the Two Huai and Huai West circuit administrations, which handled troops, horses, money and grain. Shi Songzhi, who had directed the war against Jin as Jinghu circuit commissioner, and Meng Gong, deputy commander of the imperial guard armies garrisoned at Ezhou and Jiangling, came back from the Cai prefecture front carrying the bones of the last Jin emperor to Lin'an for enshrinement in the ancestral temple. The northern expedition was planned by Zhao Kui, commissioner of the eastern Huai circuit and governor of Yangzhou, together with his brother Zhao Fan, minister of war; Quan Zicai, governor of Luzhou, led the Huai West troops as vanguard, and the generals Xu Minzi and Yang Yi each led a column bound for Luoyang. Zheng Qingzhi, Zhao Fan and Zhao Kui pressed for the war, while Shi Songzhi, Qiao Xingjian, Zhen Dexiu, Wu Yuan and Wu Qian opposed it sharply, on the grounds that the Central Plains had been ruined by years of war and could not feed an army, that the Song had no cavalry with which to hold a long Yellow River front, and that opening a new front would hand the Mongols a pretext. On the Mongol side the great khan Ogedei directed everything, but withdrew his main force across the Yellow River because of short supplies and hot weather, leaving only two mobile forces under Subutai and Tačar'er in the south of the river, and policing the country with Han troops recruited from the surrendered Jin army: Liu Fu as chief commissioner of Henan circuit, the grand marshal Zhang Rou stationed at Xuzhou, and the Jin turncoat Cui Li still holding Kaifeng. The brief understanding that had made the joint destruction of Jin possible thus turned into open war between Song and Mongol.
people: 推動這場戰役的關鍵人物分屬兩朝。南宋方面，年號端平的宋理宗趙昀是決策者，滅金捷報一到便急於收復三京，滅金後四個月內三次遣使赴河南拜謁北宋皇陵，並下詔支持趙范、趙葵所擬的踞關守河之策，態度是戰意為要、戰力次之。右丞相鄭清之是出兵方案的主要背書者，趙范、趙葵兄弟提出西守潼關、北倚黃河的部署；反對陣營以史嵩之為首，他拖延撥發淮西江東軍馬錢糧，喬行簡、真德秀、吳淵、吳潛亦持異議，理由是糧源不繼、無騎兵可恃。孟珙自蔡州送金哀宗遺骨歸臨安，是滅金與北伐之間的樞紐人物，卻未主張深入河南。全子才自廬州率淮西兵先取歸德府，是第一支進入中原的宋軍；趙葵率五萬兵由泗州抵汴京，責全子才滯留半月不進，終仍命徐敏子率一萬三千人為先鋒、楊誼率一萬五千人為接應，只帶五日口糧赴洛陽。蒙古方面，窩闊台在北撤之前佈下誘敵之局，速不台與塔察兒分率兩翼，劉亨安奉命在洛陽東龍門設伏，終致楊誼一軍覆沒；汴京金朝降將崔立被部將李伯淵所殺獻城，張柔、劉福分守徐州與河南道，維持著漢軍系統的運作。
peopleEn: The decisive personalities belonged to two courts. In the Song, Emperor Lizong of Song, Zhao Yun, whose reign title was Duanping, was the man who decided. As soon as the news of the fall of Jin arrived he was eager to recover the three capitals, and within four months of the destruction of Jin he sent envoys three times to the former Northern Song imperial tombs in Henan and issued an edict supporting the plan of Zhao Fan and Zhao Kui to hold the passes and lean on the Yellow River, on the principle that fighting spirit came first and fighting capacity second. The right chancellor Zheng Qingzhi was the chief sponsor of the expedition; the brothers Zhao Fan and Zhao Kui proposed a deployment holding the west at Tong Pass and the north against the Yellow River, while the opposing group was led by Shi Songzhi, who delayed the release of money and grain for the Huai West and Jiangdong armies, joined by Qiao Xingjian, Zhen Dexiu, Wu Yuan and Wu Qian, all of whom doubted the grain supply and the absence of cavalry. Meng Gong, who brought the bones of the Jin emperor back to Lin'an from Cai prefecture, was the hinge between the war against Jin and this expedition, yet he did not urge a deep advance into Henan. Quan Zicai marched from Luzhou with the Huai West troops and took Guidu prefecture, becoming the first Song force to enter the Central Plains. Zhao Kui arrived at Kaifeng with fifty thousand men from Suzhou and faulted Quan Zicai for staying still for half a month; he nevertheless sent Xu Minzi with thirteen thousand men as vanguard and Yang Yi with fifteen thousand as support, giving them only five days of rations for the march to Luoyang. On the Mongol side Ogedei set the trap before withdrawing north, Subutai and Tačar'er led the two wings, and Liu Heng'an was ordered to ambush at Longmen, east of Luoyang, where Yang Yi's detachment was destroyed. At Kaifeng the Jin turncoat Cui Li was killed by his own subordinate Li Boyuan, who opened the city, while Zhang Rou and Liu Fu held Xuzhou and Henan circuit and kept the Han army system working.
kits: 十字弩這件兵器在端平入洛裡位置尷尬：它是宋軍裝備序列中數量最多、卻最難在野戰中施展的冷兵器。宋軍攻城與野戰的步兵都配步弩，步軍諸營另有蹶張硬弩，號神臂弓，張弦須十數人同時用力，射程可遠壓城頭馬兵，是全軍最重的弩機；它同樣適用於城頭，用以封鎖城下騎兵的接近，但一旦蒙古騎兵貼近城根，裝填的間隙便成了致命破口。端平入洛的實際戰鬥幾乎沒有攻城一幕：汴京由金朝降將李伯淵殺主帥崔立獻出，洛陽只剩三百餘戶，宋軍入城所謂是接收空城，攻城用的穴地、雲梯一類器械根本沒有用上；反倒是守城一方佔了上風，蒙古軍攻洛陽時四面合圍、斷其水路糧道，用配重投石車與石砲打擊城頭，靠圍城斷糧迫敵出降，徐敏子一軍的崩潰正始於糧盡而非城破。蒙古本部以角弓與復合弓為主力，騎兵的射速與機動遠勝宋弩；其漢軍降卒則沿用金朝配備的排弩與床子弩，弩手編入攻城與守城序列。蒙古遠征軍另攜配重投石車、鐵撞與攻城塔，其中一部分大配重投石機是回回匠人所造，自一二三一年起已隨征金大軍轉戰河南。金朝在1232年汴京守城時用過的震天雷與飛火，戰後散在降軍與殘部手中；宋軍自北返時亦攜回大批輜重與攻城工具，只是此役之中一樣也沒派上用場。
kitsEn: The crossbow stood in an awkward place in the Duanping march to Luoyang: it was the most numerous weapon in the Song order of battle and the hardest to use in open field. Song infantry carried ordinary crossbows for both siege and field duty, and the infantry camps also had strong drawn crossbows known as shenbi bows, whose cord had to be pulled by a dozen men at once and whose range could cover cavalry on a wall; the same weapon was equally at home on a rampart, where it could check approaching horsemen, but once Mongol cavalry closed on the foot of the wall the interval needed to reload became a fatal opening. In fact almost no siege was fought in this campaign. Kaifeng was handed over by the Jin turncoat Li Boyuan, who killed the commander Cui Li, and Luoyang held barely three hundred households, so the Song entry into these cities was in effect the receipt of empty ones, and siege tools such as sap picks and scaling ladders went entirely unused. It was the defenders who dominated, for the Mongols investing Luoyang closed in on all sides, cut the water and grain routes, and struck the walls with counterweight trebuchets and stone shot, relying on starvation to force a surrender; the collapse of Xu Minzi's army began with the failure of supply, not with a breach of the wall. The Mongol core relied on horn bows and composite bows, and their mounted archers out-shot and out-manoeuvred the Song crossbowmen by a wide margin; the surrendered Han troops kept the Jin armament, including rack crossbows and bed crossbows, and crossbowmen were slotted into both siege and garrison duties. The Mongol expeditionary force also brought counterweight trebuchets, iron rams and siege towers, some of the large trebuchets being the work of Muslim engineers who had accompanied the armies against Jin in Henan since 1231. The thunder crash bombs and fire arrows the Jin had used on the walls of Kaifeng in 1232 lay scattered in the hands of surrendered men and Jin remnants afterwards, and the Song brought back large stocks of baggage and siege tools from the north, though not one of them was of use in this campaign.
tactics: 蒙古方面的戰術核心是佯退、絕糧、分割、全滅四步。塔察兒聽聞宋軍北進，率部退過黃河示弱，又事先掘開黃河南岸金朝修築的河堤，製造大範圍黃泛區，使從壽春到汴京一帶道路積水深至沒頸，宋軍糧隊被迫繞行，糧道與隊形一起斷裂。宋軍的處置則是典型的分兵冒進：全子才先取歸德府，趙葵率五萬人由泗州抵汴京後屯於城南二十里，前鋒徐敏子一萬三千人、接應楊誼一萬五千人各攜五日口糧直取洛陽，結果主軍與偏師之間缺乏接應，又無騎兵可做偵察與追擊，一旦斷糧即無退路。蒙古預判宋軍必趨洛陽，乃令部將再渡黃河，在洛陽東龍門一帶埋伏。楊誼一軍在城東遇伏幾乎全滅，蒙古軍隨即進逼洛陽，與徐敏子部對峙，圍城斷其糧道；八月初徐敏子部已斷糧四日被迫退兵，蒙古軍乘其亂掩擊，宋軍大部被消滅，汴京守軍隨之崩解。整場戰役的勝負並非在陣地交換時決定，而由糧道長度與行軍節奏決定。
tacticsEn: The Mongolian method had four steps: feigned retreat, cutting supply, separating the enemy, annihilation. Tačar'er, on hearing that Song troops were moving north, withdrew his men across the Yellow River to look weak, and beforehand broke open the embankment the Jin had built on the south bank, creating a vast area of flood so that the roads from Shouchun to Kaifeng were covered in water up to the neck and the Song grain convoys were forced to detour, the supply line and the marching order breaking together. The Song answer was a textbook of divided and reckless advance. Quan Zicai took Guidu prefecture first; Zhao Kui arrived at Kaifeng with fifty thousand men and camped twenty li south of the city; the vanguard Xu Minzi with thirteen thousand men and the supporting force Yang Yi with fifteen thousand each took only five days of rations and marched straight for Luoyang, so that main body and flank were never in touch, no cavalry existed for scouting or pursuit, and once supply failed there was no way back. The Mongols calculated that the Song would press on to Luoyang and ordered detachments across the Yellow River again to lie in ambush at Longmen, east of the city. Yang Yi's force was caught in the open east of town and almost wiped out, and the Mongols then closed on Luoyang and stood off against Xu Minzi's men, besieging the city and cutting its grain route; in early August, four days after the grain had run out, Xu Minzi's force had to withdraw, and the Mongols fell on the disordered retreat and destroyed the bulk of it, after which the Song garrison at Kaifeng collapsed in turn. Nothing in this campaign was decided by the exchange of front lines; it was decided by the length of the supply line and the tempo of the march.
data: 可考證的數字集中在兵力與日期兩端。端平元年六月十二日，全子才率淮西兵萬餘人收復歸德府，是宋軍首次進入河南；七月二日該軍抵汴京郊外二十里紮營；七月五日全子才入汴京，城中守軍只餘六百餘人，居民一千多家，與北宋時逾百萬人口的城市已不可同日而語。七月二十日，趙葵率兵五萬由泗州抵達開封。赴洛的兩支大軍是徐敏子一萬三千人與楊誼一萬五千人，只帶五天口糧；七月末徐敏子進洛陽時，全城只剩三百餘戶；占領次日，楊誼一部在城東遭劉亨安部伏擊，幾乎全軍覆沒。八月初中原斷糧已四日，徐敏子部被迫撤退，宋軍大部被消滅。整場行動自六月十二日開拔到八月初崩潰，歷時不足兩個月，宋軍向鄭州、陳州、蔡州方向的偏師僅零星推進，未能形成攻勢。孟珙所部自蔡州班師、運回金哀宗遺骨，亦是此役得以發動的時間前提。
dataEn: The figures that can be documented cluster around strengths and dates. On the twelfth day of the sixth month of the first year of Duanping, Quan Zicai with more than ten thousand Huai West troops recovered Guidu prefecture, the first Song penetration into Henan; on the second of the seventh month that army reached the outskirts of Kaifeng and camped twenty li from the walls; on the fifth of the seventh month Quan Zicai entered Kaifeng, where the garrison had been reduced to some six hundred men and the population to a little over a thousand households, a city no longer comparable to the metropolis of more than a million people under the Northern Song. On the twentieth of the seventh month Zhao Kui reached Kaifeng with fifty thousand men from Suzhou. The two columns sent against Luoyang were Xu Minzi's thirteen thousand and Yang Yi's fifteen thousand, supplied with only five days of rations. At the end of the seventh month Xu Minzi entered Luoyang, where only some three hundred households remained; on the day after the occupation Yang Yi was ambushed east of the city by the troops of Liu Heng'an and almost entirely destroyed. In early August, four days after the grain had run out, Xu Minzi's force withdrew and the bulk of the Song army was destroyed. The whole operation, from the march out on the twelfth of the sixth month to the collapse in early August, lasted less than two months, and the detachments pushed toward Zhengzhou, Chenzhou and Caizhou made only scattered progress without ever forming a coherent offensive. The arrival of Meng Gong's army from Cai prefecture, bringing the bones of the Jin emperor home, was the precondition in time that made the expedition possible at all.
cause: 起因是金朝在端平元年正月覆亡後，中原出現權力真空，而南宋朝廷認為這是收復三京、恢復中原的難得窗口。蒙古大汗窩闊台因糧草不足、天氣轉熱把主力北撤過黃河，河南只剩速不台、塔察兒率領的兩支部隊與收編的金朝漢軍，防守力量一時空疏。趙范、趙葵兄弟據此提出踞關守河之策：西守潼關、北倚黃河，據三京以為屏障，取開封、洛陽、應天府，並藉收復北宋皇陵重振正統名分。理宗接納其議，滅金後四個月內三次遣使入河南拜謁祖陵，下詔支持出兵。反對者的顧慮同樣是實在的：中原經歷多年戰亂已破敗殆盡，無法就地籌糧；宋軍以步兵為主，無騎兵便難守漫長的黃河防線，也難追擊北撤之敵；且宋蒙方在聯軍滅金，此時開邊等於自毀盟約。史嵩之以權樞密之柄拖延撥發淮西江東軍馬錢糧，喬行簡、真德秀、吳淵、吳潛紛紛力言不可，理由皆是糧源與騎兵。理宗以戰意為要、戰力次之，終究不聽。
causeEn: The cause lay in the collapse of the Jin in the first month of the first year of Duanping, which left a vacuum of authority in the Central Plains, and in the Southern Song court's conviction that this was a rare opening to recover the three capitals and restore the middle kingdom. The great khan Ogedei had withdrawn his main force north of the Yellow River because of short supplies and hot weather, leaving in Henan only the two columns of Subutai and Tačar'er together with the surrendered Jin Han troops, so that the defence was for a time conspicuously thin. The brothers Zhao Fan and Zhao Kui built their scheme on that fact: hold the west at Tong Pass, lean on the Yellow River in the north, base themselves on the three capitals, take Kaifeng, Luoyang and Yingtian, and use the recovery of the Northern Song imperial tombs to re-establish the legitimacy of the dynasty. Lizong accepted the plan and, within four months of the fall of Jin, sent envoys three times to worship at the ancestral tombs in Henan and issued an edict backing the expedition. The objections raised were equally practical: the Central Plains had been wasted by long war and could not provision the army; the Song army was infantry and without cavalry could neither hold a long Yellow River line nor chase the enemy as it withdrew north; and the Song and the Mongols had just been allies in destroying Jin, so opening a new front meant breaking a treaty. Shi Songzhi, holding the military portfolio, delayed the release of money and grain for the Huai West and Jiangdong troops, while Qiao Xingjian, Zhen Dexiu, Wu Yuan and Wu Qian argued against the war in turn, on grounds of supply and cavalry. Lizong, putting fighting spirit before fighting capacity, did not listen.
impact: 端平入洛的失敗把宋蒙之間短暫的聯合徹底翻為敵對。蒙古得以指斥宋廷毀約：1234年年底，蒙古使者王檝抵達臨安譴責敗盟；1235年春，窩闊台命皇子闊端與曲出分道出師攻宋，宋蒙戰爭全面爆發，中原與江淮一線的邊患比預期提早數十年到來。軍事上，宋軍不但沒有收回三京，反而在洛陽與汴京折損數萬兵員，兩地仍歸蒙古控制，南宋退守秦嶺淮河，長江與四川成為唯一依託。經濟上，河南既失，漕運北端斷絕，軍費與糧源更形困窘。政治上，此役之後朝野追責，賈似道以援軍之功入樞府並推行端平更化，一面向蒙古求和，一面向內整頓，卻也種下中央與邊軍、荊襄諸將互不信任的病根。此役更明白地顯示：宋軍之敗不在器械，而在機動與後勤——弩手在斷糧的荒野上比不上一支飽食的騎兵，而三京之內到處是空城與白骨，接收無所得，供應無所出。
impactEn: The failure of the Duanping march to Luoyang turned the brief alliance between Song and Mongol into open hostility. The Mongols gained the pretext to charge the Song court with breaking faith: at the end of 1234 the Mongol envoy Wang Ji reached Lin'an to denounce the Song for violating the alliance, and in the spring of 1235 Ogedei sent the princes Köden and Chüchü to attack Song from different directions, so that the war between Song and Mongols broke out in full and the frontier threat of the Central Plains and the Jianghuai arrived several decades earlier than had been expected. Militarily the Song recovered nothing: it lost tens of thousands of men at Luoyang and Kaifeng, both cities stayed in Mongol hands, and the Song fell back on the Qinling-Huai river line, with the Yangtze and Sichuan as its only remaining supports. Economically the loss of Henan cut off the northern end of the grain transport, and military costs became still harder to bear. Politically the court turned to recrimination after the defeat: Jia Sidao entered the Bureau of Military Affairs on the credit of bringing reinforcements and carried out the Duanping reforms, seeking peace with the Mongols while disciplining the interior, but in doing so sowed the mistrust between the centre and the frontier commands and the generals of Jingxiang and Xiangyang that would bear fruit later. The campaign also demonstrated clearly that the Song defeat was not about weapons but about mobility and supply: on a starved plain a crossbowman is no match for a fed horse, while the three capitals were everywhere empty cities and white bones, yielding nothing to receive and nothing to provision from.
result: 結果是宋軍全敗。三京之役既以失敗收場，趙葵與全子才相率引軍退入秦嶺淮河防線，前鋒徐敏子部在斷糧四日出退時遭蒙古掩擊，大部被消滅；接應的楊誼一軍在洛陽城東中伏後幾乎全軍覆沒；先行抵達的兩萬八千人無一生還之說雖屬誇飾，回援無望的結局則是確鑿。收復三京的目標全部落空：開封與洛陽隨即為蒙古軍控制，應天府歸德府重陷，趙葵西進的計畫中止，北宋皇陵仍在蒙古治下。代價除折損兵員、耗盡北伐以來的儲備外，更在於宋廷的對蒙策略轉為被動，收復三京自此成為廢案，宋軍在河南亦再無建制駐紮。端平入洛之後，宋蒙之間再無蜜月，一二三五年起的全面戰爭把南宋推入長達數十年的邊患，直至襄陽、樊城陷落而有崖山之敗。
resultEn: The result was a total Song defeat. The three capitals were not regained. Zhao Kui and Quan Zicai led the army back to the Qinling-Huai river line; the vanguard Xu Minzi was forced to retreat in early August after four days without food and was cut down by the Mongols in the disorder, while the supporting force Yang Yi was ambushed east of Luoyang and almost annihilated; the claim that not one of the twenty-eight thousand who reached Luoyang came back is an exaggeration, but the fact of a hopeless position is beyond dispute. Every objective was lost: Kaifeng and Luoyang passed into Mongol control, Guidu prefecture was abandoned, Zhao Kui's plan to advance west was cancelled, and the imperial tombs of the Northern Song remained under foreign rule. The price, besides men and the resources of two campaigns, was the strategic posture of the Song court, which became purely defensive; the recovery of the three capitals was abandoned as a scheme, and the Song maintained no formed garrison in Henan thereafter. There was no more month of honeymoon between Song and Mongols after Duanping; the full-scale war beginning in 1235 drove the Song into decades of frontier fighting, ending in the fall of Xiangyang and Fancheng and then the disaster of Yashan.
